title: The documentation-migration preservation check no longer passes, so the preserved-block markers pin nothing
why: `docs/reports/docs-structure-compression/verify.py` reconstructs the four pre-restructure guides from the `<!-- preserved:KEY -->` blocks named in its `migration.json`. At base `8c1f15eb` it exits 1 on its first row (`AGENTS.md` -> `docs/development/architecture.md`, key `architecture`), a current page later cards legitimately edited; eight rows were already edited in place (`architecture`, `entry-points`, `further-reading`, `hard-invariants`, `constraint-16`, `constraint-18`, `constraint-25`, `validation`) and `operations` carries no markers. DOCS-COMPACT-9 (wave 45) edited four more by integrator decision (gateway `constraint-5c`, `constraint-7`, `constraint-8` and `diagnostic-namespaces`), moving their migration text with its markers verbatim into docs/development/increments/wave-45-compaction-checkpoints.md. The script is a frozen report's and is not edited (constraint 21). The blocks still marked preserved are the other 59 rows of `migration.json`, listed row by row in docs/reports/docs-compact-9/artifacts/preserved-blocks-after.txt. DISCHARGE: a live check (for example under `scripts/`, run by the Python suite) that verifies each still-preserved block against its checkpoint copy (the migration source commit, or a named checkpoint page for an edited block), or a recorded retirement of the preservation pin that lists the blocks it covered.

title: Three frozen reconciliation claims held only by a substring match inside an unrelated figure
why: `reconciliation_sweep.py --check` verifies a `{file, contains}` claim by substring containment on normalised text. Three frozen claims assert that docs/STATUS.md contains `281`, their records' follow-up count: `canonical-contract-locations#integrator-reconciliation-list#4` (verify item 1, in docs/reports/canonical-contract-locations/reconciliation.json) and `cycle18-timeout-teardown#integrator-reconciliation-list#5` and `cycle18-wait-failures#integrator-reconciliation-list#5` (verify item 0 each, in docs/reports/cycle18-priority1-integration/reconciliation.json). At base `8c1f15eb` the page carried 472 follow-ups and the three matched only inside `17,281`, an indirect-access leaf count of an unrelated row, so they were vacuous before DOCS-COMPACT-9; its compaction moved that figure to a checkpoint and they now fail. They are not rewritten (frozen records; the integration policy lets a close check its own record against its own tree). No gate or CI step runs them: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs no reconciliation check, the standing gate does not, and scripts/tests exercise the sweep only on temporary fixtures; they run only when a close checks its own record by hand (docs/agents/operations.md, Integration and reconciliation). DISCHARGE: the sweep's containment check is anchored to a token or a named field, so a figure cannot match inside another number, or these three claims are marked historical in a way the check honours.
